description: Public PressureEqualizer output preserves endpoint extrusion while applying the external-only smoothing boundary to tagged roles, for both absolute and relative E. The fixture opens the adjustable-flow block with a G1 F600 ;_EXTRUDE_SET_SPEED line.

mutants.description: Disable the positive-direction external-only bypass at its rate_start gate. The internal-perimeter control must then gain smoothing splits and fail its exact four-move/one-marker assertions.

Discard the public extrusion-role marker and force every tagged segment to an internal perimeter. The external-only row must then lose its smoothing split, failing its positive physical output assertions.
